note: Reading of the brief (log §1): the torso lowers backward onto the FOLDED-side flank / back with the chest turned open toward the tackling side, and the folded-side (balance) arm posts — the reference's posting hand, lying side and folded leg are all the same side. SP2C's recovery trigger is removed. F37.5 temporary, not recalibrated.
